title: Keep response alias fields and optional metadata mapping with backward-compatible signature rules
prompt: Update response.py with backward-compatible signature rules so serialize(resource_id, *, metadata=None) preserves existing positional calls and returns both 'id' and 'resource_id' fields with the same value. When optional keyword-only metadata is supplied, validate that it is a Mapping (raising TypeError for non-Mapping inputs) and store an independent shallow dict copy under 'metadata' without mutating caller input. When metadata is omitted, return only the two existing fields. Do not edit the protected acceptance file.
